findings.problem: The example uses words not met before this card: español, thank, you. In the frequency phase it may use at most two words not met yet.

back.es: How is ... said? / How do you say ...?
back.example: How do you say "thank you" in Spanish?

note: The hint is useful because it rules out the literal ¿Cómo dices…? and points to the impersonal se, which is the standard way to ask this.
